processors.name: LogMessage
processors.comments: Error sink: records that fail JSON conversion or RecordPath mapping are logged here (WARN + bulletin) instead of being dropped silently. A durable/recoverable dead-letter sink can later replace this terminal node without changing the surrounding wiring.

properties.log-message: Pipeline record dropped (cause in the failing processor's bulletin): httpStatus=${invokehttp.status.code} exception=${invokehttp.java.exception.class} file=${uuid}

processors.name: SplitEntities
processors.comments: Splits a JSON array (e.g. $.things or $.observations of the STA envelope) into one FlowFile per element so each entity can be resolved (find-or-create) individually.

processors.name: ExtractJson
processors.comments: Extracts values from the FlowFile JSON into attributes (e.g. the entity reference, or the @iot.id from a lookup response). The dynamic attribute->JsonPath properties are set per instance by the flow builder.

processors.name: RouteExists
processors.comments: Routes an entity FlowFile by whether the find lookup resolved an @iot.id: a matching dynamic relationship (e.g. 'exists') vs. 'unmatched' (new). The dynamic relationship/expression is set per instance by the flow builder.

processors.name: RestoreEntityBody
processors.comments: Restores the entity object as the FlowFile content after a lookup GET overwrote it with the response, so the subsequent POST sends the entity (the entity JSON was captured into an attribute before the lookup). Replacement Value is set per instance by the flow builder.
